newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: American Express to launch rand cheques.
newsitem.headline: American Express to launch rand cheques.

text.p: American Express announced on Friday it planned to set up a joint venture with a number of South African banks which would begin issuing rand travellers cheques early next year.
The new company, whose formation is subject to South African Reserve Bank and Registrar of Banks approval, would be known as South African Travellers Cheque Co.

The partner banks, which include Nedcor Ltd and Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd, would cease distribution of their own brand cheques early in 1998, while American Express would distribute the cheques through its network of over 1,700 offices worldwide.
The Travellers Cheque would bear the same world-wide acceptance and refundability features associated with American Express, it said in a statement.
The launch of the rand cheques would bring to 12 the number of cheque currencies American Express offered.
